examples: Rename sessions after the task they are on (billing-bug, docs-pass) instead of the folder name.
Tell two sessions in the same folder apart.
how_to: Choose rename from the row menu, or press F2 on the selected row.
Type the new name and press Enter. The drawer, the tab and the home screen all use it.
name: Rename a session
summary: give a session its own name instead of the one claude or codex picked for it.
where: Or select a row in the drawer and press F2.
